verse.name: v1
v2
verse.lines:
Glory, let us give, and blessing
to the Father and the Son:
Honour, might, and praise addressing
while eternal ages run;
Equal praise to Him, confessing,
who proceeds from Both as One. Amen.

verse.name: e1
verse.lines:
℣: You have given them bread from Heaven.
R: Having in itself all delight.

verse.name: e2
verse.lines:
Priest:
Let us pray.
O God, in this wonderful sacrament,
You have left us a memorial of Your passion.

We ask You to enable us
so to worship the sacred mysteries
of Your body and blood

That we may constantly feel in our lives
the effects of Your redemption
You who live and reign forever and ever
R: Amen
